fact: The Minister of Home Affairs told the National Assembly that registered voters could inspect the provisional register online through the ECZ website or by dialling USSD *214#, and physically at all 12,152 polling stations, until 8 March 2026.

The Minister said the ECZ had deployed 2,354 Biometric Voter Registration kits nationwide and had run de-duplication and data cleansing on the provisional register of 8,861,918 voters, which was also served electronically.
The AU-COMESA mission says the ECZ used a hybrid manual and digital system, with an online pre-registration portal, to register the 8,786,300 voters on the 2026 register.
system: hybrid manual and digital voter registration system

fact: The EU mission says the ECZ's online pre-registration portal enabled registered voters to electronically inspect the Provisional Register of Voters.

The EU mission says the ECZ certified and published a voter register of 8,786,300 on 4 May 2026 and that digital kits were used in registration, with technical difficulties reported by some interlocutors.
The SADC mission says the voters' register was displayed at 201 of 277 polling stations observed (73 per cent) on polling day.
